description:
Code path: find_san at pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:788-799 calls SubjectAltName::from_der on every verify_* invocation. The decode allocates a Vec<GeneralName> per call.

Expected impact at scale: AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 explicitly calls out batch validation and prevalidation as supported use cases. A truststore adapter that asks 'what identities does this anchored cert claim?' (per the lib.rs:26-28 example) currently has no efficient way to enumerate identities without re-parsing per-question. Likewise, a verifier checking one cert against N candidate identities pays N * SAN-parse cost.

Recommendation (post-1.0 is fine if surface needs to fossilize first):
- Expose a public ParsedIdentities (or similar) cache struct that holds the decoded SubjectAltName and exposes verify_dns_name_against / verify_mailbox_against methods. Callers that need batch checks against many identities pay one SAN-parse.
- Keep the free functions verify_dns_name / verify_mailbox as thin convenience wrappers that build the cache then drop it.

Not blocking 1.0 — the current free-function shape is the right default. But this seam should land before users start hitting the cost.
title: verify_dns_name and verify_mailbox re-parse SAN on every call (no batch-friendly seam)
